zh: 最终串由若干个abc块拼接而成，原串中落在同一个块里的字符必须严格递增（a<b<c）。
因此只要相邻两个原字符不是严格递增（后一个不大于前一个），它们之间就必须切到下一个块；而按这些位置切开后，每段都是abc的子序列，都能补全成abc。
块数等于1加上相邻位置中s[i]≤s[i−1]的次数；答案为3×块数−原串长度。
en: The final string is a concatenation of abc blocks, and the original characters that fall in the same block must be strictly increasing (a<b<c).

So whenever two adjacent original characters are not strictly increasing (the later one is not greater than the earlier one), a new block must start between them; after cutting at these places, every piece is a subsequence of abc and can be completed to abc.
The number of blocks is 1 plus the number of adjacent positions with s[i]≤s[i−1]; the answer is 3 × blocks − original length.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Whenever adjacent characters are not strictly increasing, a new abc block must start; multiply the number of blocks by 3 and subtract the original length.

## Proof of correctness

The original characters kept within one abc block must be strictly increasing, so every non-increasing boundary forces a cut. After cutting at these boundaries, each block is a subsequence of abc and can be completed to abc, which reaches the forced lower bound on the number of blocks.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).
